registry_info.name: neuroscience
registry_info.description: Computational neuroscience artifacts — Markov blankets, perception, and the boundary between self and environment. Where information theory meets biology.
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Free energy principle, Markov blankets, active inference, perception as Bayesian inference, sensory processing

puls_markov.name: Pulsing Markov Blanket
puls_markov.description: Markov blanket cell simulation with noise-driven pulsing and entropy measurement. Visualizes the statistical boundary between internal states and external environment — the free energy principle made tangible.

perception_altering.name: Perception Altering Environment
perception_altering.description: Environmental perception distortion through shader manipulation and spatial warping. Experience how altered sensory parameters change the felt quality of space — perception as active construction, not passive recording.
